target_claim: The proof asserts flatly that $a \notin M$ (line 0014), and uses this to upgrade $M \subseteq N$ to the strict inclusion $M \subsetneq N$. Nothing in the statement as given constrains $a$ at all, so this assertion is unjustified, and both it and the conclusion $M \subsetneq N$ fail on a concrete two-element distributive lattice.
